sentences.en: When you put money in the bank, you deposit it.
sentences.zh: 把钱存到银行里，就是存款。

sentences.en: You are required to provide three months' rent in deposit.
sentences.zh: 你必须提供三个月租金作为押金。

sentences.en: She deposited a large sum of money in the bank.
sentences.zh: 她把一大笔钱存进了银行。

senses.zh: 存款；押金；订金；保证金；沉淀物
